title: Claude Now Runs My Entire Meta Ad Account
description:
Meta has run an official Ads MCP connector since 29 April 2026, giving Claude 29 campaign-management tools on your own ad account. Higgsfield shipped its official connector on 30 April 2026, exposing 30+ image and video models through one endpoint.

Connect both and the loop closes: Claude ranks your creatives by cost per purchase, works out the pattern behind the winners, briefs new variations, generates them, and pushes them back as a new ad set. Everything it creates lands paused, and authentication runs through your own Meta account rather than a shared third-party app.

Get the connector URLs and the four prompts that run the loop here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-w3M3U1i_MDeSJVnNPkLRIb0tscXLOVJklbAs7rJTtw/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #MetaAds #ClaudeAI
transcript: This new meta update is absolutely insane. You can now connect Meta's MCP directly into Claude. Meta has been running its own official connector since the end of April, and it hands Claude 29 tools for your ad account. Connected and Claude reads every campaign you're running and tells you which creatives are actually making money. Then you plug in Higgs Field, which brings 30 plus image and video models into the same chat. Now Claude takes your winning ad, builds new versions of it, and pushes them back into your account. Your best ads write the next ads. Comment flywheel and I'll send you the setup guide.
